Both order things the way I'd want — I picked "Name A–Z" in each and the list rearranged right away without changing any of the cards, and it's good to know I can also do newest and oldest.

Between the two, I'll go with the **menu version**. A single little "Sort" dropdown feels tidier to me and keeps things calm, especially as the number of sort choices grows — a row of buttons starts to feel cluttered and takes up space I'd rather give to my bookmarks. So let's use the drop-down menu for choosing the order. That settles sorting for me.
